regions.today: Today will be dry with a mix of cloud and sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 19 to 23 degrees, warmest in the south, with light north to northwest winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees with light and variable winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will start mostly cloudy but some sunny spells will develop as the day goes on, turning hazy later. Highest temperatures of 20 to 24 degrees, warmest in the south, with a light to moderate west to northwest breeze.
regions.solar_uv: High or Moderate on Thursday and Friday.
